attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), built an LVM logical volume (data_vg/data_lv) backed by two loop devices over files in /var/lib/lvm-backing, formatted ext4, and mounted it at /srv/data. Grew the VG/LV online from 1000M to 2.05GiB (>=2GB) by adding a second loop-backed PV and running lvextend + resize2fs while the volume stayed mounted, with pre-existing test data verified byte-identical afterward via sha256sum. Persisted the setup across reboot by installing a custom OpenRC service (/etc/init.d/loop-devices, boot runlevel, depends on 'need root' and 'before lvm') that reattaches the loop devices and activates the VG before the stock lvm/localmount services run, plus an /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data. Iterated through three reboot cycles to debug and fix boot-ordering races (loop devices attaching read-only before root remounted rw, then LVM not yet active when localmount ran) until the final reboot showed the LV auto-activating, /srv/data auto-mounting at 2.0G, and both data files (testfile.txt, blob.bin) intact with matching checksums — with a new OS boot_id confirming an actual restart each time.
